title: Regular unit and constraints for normalized scalar tensors
statement: For any morphism a of commutative condensed rings, scheme T and TensorIso b satisfying TensorNormalized, both actual scalar regular unit maps are isomorphisms and b satisfies associativity and the two unit equations with derivedScalarUnit. The maps and equations are exactly UnitCondition of [def-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-data].

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 0G7E, 07A4, 07A6; sites-modules.tex Tags 03EK and 03EL. Extracted from lem-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-normalization.

proof.text: The K-flat degree-zero regular module has an invertible scalar computation map; localization of the ordinary unit and single-functor comparison give the regular-unit isomorphism. Identify the generic derived oplax unit and tensorator with the specified maps and apply its associativity and left and right unit laws. Uniqueness transfers the laws to every normalized tensorator.
